text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also powers translation tools that change text from one language into another quickly. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where computers identify whether a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions in a friendly way. Thanks to NLP, our daily interactions with technology are becoming easier and more natural.
